title: A Calypso Caramba
summary: A man is poisoned while Neville is at the same bar.
method: The man put the narcotic into the bottle and everyone drank out of it, but he ordered a side of salt which is supposed to induce vomiting. He then used a printed label to disguise the bottle and swapped glasses with Neville.
motive: The killer was upset at the victim for abandoning his daughter, and she happens to be another singer.
